Interface ComponentInterface

All Superinterfaces:
dermi.ERemote
public interface ComponentInterface
extends dermi.ERemote

This remote interface is implemented by any Dermi component. All Dermi components exported interfaces must implement it. It provides the activation and passivation callbacks as well as the queryInterface method, la COM's IUnknown
